name: Mirror Lake
summary: Water spills into Mirror Lake beneath Stormwind's cliffs in northwestern Elwynn Forest, near an orchard. Defias bandits prowl the surrounding orchards, while mages watch for trouble in the forest's arcane currents.

sections.title: A Troubled Idyl
sections.body: Mirror Lake lies beneath Stormwind City's walls, where fishermen and weary travelers might seek a quiet rest. Defias Brotherhood brigands stalk the surrounding orchards, making a long stay perilous for locals. Mystical disturbances across Azeroth have also begun to warp the forest's natural channels of arcane energy. Mages from the Wizard's Sanctum watch the lake closely. They send practitioners to sample its currents and guard against chaotic arcane runoff poisoning communities downstream.

faq.answer: Defias bandits prowl the area around Mirror Lake and prey on travelers and farmers. Recent shifts in regional magic have also raised concern about the lake's water.

faq.q: Why are mages studying Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Massive magical conflicts across Azeroth have unsettled ley currents throughout Elwynn Forest and Stormwind. The Wizard's Sanctum sends initiates to sample the lake's water for unstable arcane residue that could affect those who drink from it.

faq.q: Where does the waterfall at Mirror Lake come from?
faq.answer: The waterfall comes from the high cliffs and waterways around Stormwind City. Its water feeds the lake before winding through the Elwynn river system.

angles.text: Initiates studying at Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum come here to gather water samples. The work shows how turbulent arcane channels can seep into the natural world.
The lake lies close to Stormwind's walls, while the kingdom's guards are stretched thin against Defias outlaws in the surrounding area.
